title: Applied Materials: Sanding Atoms - [Business Breakdowns, EP.118]
summary: Last week, we looked at the other leading equipment maker, ASML; and while that business currently has a higher market cap, Applied Materials generated more revenue and earnings last year. It invested $3 billion in R&D, and it currently enjoys a portfolio of 17,300 patents. To explore the business behind those numbers, I'm joined by Dylan Patel, Chief Analyst at SemiAnalysis.
